name: ZCX_CSM_IMP_OBJ_INSTNS
description: Represents a details of artifacts migrated from source to target environment using CSM.  e.g. Custom Objects, Roles,  Email Templates,  Roles Permissions for Custom Objects.

columns.name: IMP_OBJ_INSTN_ID
columns.description: Primary Key attribute to uniquely identify a row.

columns.name: IMP_OBJ_ID
columns.description: Identifies the CSM artifact that is being imported using the import profile.

columns.name: IMP_OBJ_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the type of CSM artifact that is being imported using the import profile.

columns.name: EXISTS_IN_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Artifact exists in the source environment boolean value indicator. 'Y' to indicate that the artifacts that has been\will be imported in target environment via CSM  exists in the source environment.

columns.name: EXISTS_IN_TARGET_FLAG
columns.description: Artifact exists in the target environment boolean value indicator. 'Y' to indicate that the artifacts that has been\will be imported in target environment via CSM  exists in the target environment.

columns.name: OBJECT_IMPORT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: The code representing whether to import the object group: IMPORT, DO NOT IMPORT.

columns.name: SOURCE_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Last Update timestamp of the imported Source Object when the import action was applied.

columns.name: TARGET_LAST_IMPORT_DATE
columns.description: Last Update timestamp of the Target Object After the import action was applied

columns.name: UPDATED_IN_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Artifact updated in the source environment boolean value indicator. 'Y' to indicate that the object that will be imported in target environment via CSM  is a new  version of the object in the source environment.

columns.name: UPDATED_IN_TARGET_FLAG
columns.description: Artifact updated in the target environment boolean value indicator. 'Y' to indicate that the object that will be imported in target environment via CSM  has a new  version of the object in the target environment since the last time the object was object was imported from source.

columns.name: OBJ_IMP_ACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The code representing the status of the imported object from the source: PENDING, APPLIED, APPLIED WITH ERROR, RESTORED, NOT_RESTORED_DUE_TO_TGT_CUST.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_PLAN
columns.description: The plan to execute when the object is imported in the target environment. the plan is built using the comparison data of the object in the source and target environment and the import option choice selected by the user for the object.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_RESULTS
columns.description: The results of the plan that was executed after the object was imported in the target environment.

columns.name: RESTORE_ACTION_PLAN
columns.description: The plan to execute when the object is restored in the target environment.

columns.name: RESTORE_ACTION_RESULTS
columns.description: The results of the plan that was executed after the object was restored in the target environment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
